# Last Actor run's reboot

The API endpoint described in this section is a convenience endpoint that reboots the Actor's last run.

Same as of functionality described in: [Reboot run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-run-reboot-post.md)

<!-- -->

## [Reboot Actor's last run](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-reboot-post.md)

[/actors/{actorId}/runs/last/reboot](https://docs.apify.com/api/v2/actor-runs-last-reboot-post.md)
